verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an enterprise authentication and identity platform, not an AI agent or assistant. It has no agent runtime that would consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this product type. The MCP evidence covers other roles: AuthKit securing access to customers' MCP servers, and WorkOS's own remote management MCP server for external agents. Neither shows WorkOS acting as an MCP client.
